insight: Built on its open-source Marker (~29k★) PDF-to-markdown converter and the Surya OCR toolkit (~19k★) covering 90+ languages.
name: Datalab
tagline: High-accuracy document parsing — PDFs and images to markdown, JSON, and HTML.
description: Datalab turns PDFs, images, and office documents into clean markdown, JSON, and HTML with layout, table, math, and code preservation. It is the commercial, hosted layer over the open-source Marker converter and Surya OCR toolkit, offered as a pay-as-you-go API with a free monthly allowance, while the underlying models stay free to self-host for research and small startups.

modelSupport.notes: Runs its own document AI models (Marker + Surya); optional LLM pass for extra accuracy.

edge: Open-source-rooted parsing (Marker + Surya) you can self-host for free or call as a hosted API, with strong table and math handling.
cons: Best results may need an LLM pass
